ee4b276e62.q: How did the NAFTA renegotiation achieve bipartisan support in the first Trump administration?
ee4b276e62.a: CJ Mahoney explains that the renegotiation succeeded by accommodating both Democratic and Republican priorities, particularly labor standards in Mexico, which appealed to Trump's new coalition of Reagan Democrats as well as traditional Democrats concerned with unfair labor advantages. The agreement ultimately passed with more votes than any trade agreement since the late 1980s, reflecting genuine alignment of interests between both parties.

4b412b9da7.q: How did Meta defend itself in the FTC bench trial over Instagram and WhatsApp acquisitions?
4b412b9da7.a: Meta argued that the FTC's attempt to unwind the acquisitions was problematic because they occurred long ago and Instagram was a small organization with only a couple hundred people and very low revenue when purchased. Meta contended that Instagram's growth required huge investments in infrastructure and talent from Meta, and that unwinding the acquisition would be an unprecedented remedy. Judge Bozberg issued a thoughtful opinion that Meta believes will hold up on appeal to the D.C. Circuit.

b5f2cd9c78.q: What unintended consequences has Australia's social media ban for minors created?
b5f2cd9c78.a: In Australia, as responsible companies like Meta have complied with the ban, kids have found workarounds using VPNs and other technology, and the restriction has pushed children onto less safe parts of the Internet. CJ Mahoney characterizes this as an example of legislators responding to genuine problems without solving them and potentially creating counterproductive outcomes.
